props.name: source
props.comment: The array field path RELATIVE to the ambient source scope.

props.name: label
props.comment: Explicit label, or `false` to hide it. Absent → humanized `source`.

props.name: helperText
props.comment: Helper text rendered below the iterator.

props.name: validate
props.comment: Array-level validators (e.g. `minLength`) — composed, first error wins.

props.name: defaultValue
props.comment: The array's default value (seeds an untouched hole).

props.name: scalar
props.comment: Force scalar-row mode (a `string[]`/`number[]`); DETECTED when omitted.

props.name: itemDefaults
props.comment: Object-row defaults merged into a new row (object mode).

props.name: addLabel
props.comment: Label for the add-row button. Absent → translated "Add".

props.name: disabled
props.comment: Hides every row control: add, clear, remove and reorder.

props.name: disableRemove
props.comment:
Hides the remove buttons, and the clear button with them. A function
decides per row index.

props.name: disableReordering
props.comment: Hides the move up / move down buttons.

props.name: inline
props.comment: Lays a row's inputs out in one line from the `sm` breakpoint up.

props.name: getItemLabel
props.comment:
A label per row. `true` numbers rows from 1; a function returns the label
for a row index; `false` renders none.

slots.name: remove-button
slots.type: { index: number; remove: () => void; reOrder: (to: number) => void; }

slots.name: reorder-buttons
slots.type: { index: number; remove: () => void; reOrder: (to: number) => void; }
